scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit finite state and collineation certificates, reconstructed independently in Python and C++; no outside validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact statement for the fourteen-element binary Fano incidence poset; no extension to arbitrary projective-plane orders or general dynamical theory is proved. Potential equivalent unindexed literature remains a priority risk.
title: Seven collineation types and order \(105\) of Fano-incidence rowmotion
